description: Search active or historical commercial ads from the Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ad Library by keyword or brand without Meta Graph API identity verification (2 credits per ad, min 10 credits).

active_status.description: Filter by status: active, inactive, or all

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code or ALL (e.g. US, GB, DE, ALL)

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor from previous response

query.description: Brand, product, or advertiser search query (aliases: q, keyword, advertiser)

name: facebook_ads_search

data.description: Paginated list of commercial ad creatives with performance telemetry and creative assets.

ads.description: Array of ad creative records (ad_id, advertiser, copy, CTA, impressions/CTR, video URLs).

hasMore.description: Whether more ad creatives are available.

title: Search Meta / Facebook Ad Library
